:::{#sol-derive-bernoulli-score-deviation}

Starting from @sol-derive-bernoulli-score:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&= \frac{x - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(score, with $\precision$ written out)}\\
&= \frac{x - \prob}{\Var{X}}
&& \text{($\Var{X} = \prob(1 - \prob)$)}\\
&= \precision (x - \prob)
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}\\
&= \precision \paren{x - \E{X}}
&& \text{($\E{X} = \prob$)}\\
&= \precision \devn
&& \text{(definition of $\devn$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
